neuroSHARE.label: neuroSHARE Standard Intro
neuroSHARE.content:
Welcome to the neuroSHARE Survey

This survey will take about 20–25 minutes to complete.

Expect assignments focused on:

  • Speech & Voice
  • Sleep
  • Colour vision
  • Hearing
  • Thinking skills

standard.label: neuroSHARE Standard Instructions
standard.content:
Before you start

  • Find a quiet space: Sit at a table in a room without interruptions. Please close any windows and turn off the TV or background noise.
  • Disconnect headphones: Please use your device's built-in microphone and speakers.
  • Check your device battery and internet connection: Make sure your internet connection is stable and your battery is sufficiently charged.
